name: Warm Beet-Sweet Potato Salad with Chickpeas, Arugula & Tahini Yogurt
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan and pat dry with paper towels.
Peel, trim, and medium dice beets. Add to the baking sheet with the chickpeas.
Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle chickpeas and veggies with oil, then season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are crisp and veggies are fork-tender, about 25 minutes.
Meanwhile, zest and juice one lemon into a small bowl (set remaining lemon aside for the next step). Add yogurt, tahini, and salt; whisk to combine the tahini yogurt. Set aside.
Juice remaining lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
When the chickpeas and veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add half of the parsley to the baking sheet and toss to combine. (Reserve remaining parsley for serving.)
Add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat.
To serve, spoon the tahini yogurt over the bottom of each plate. Top with the dressed arugula, chickpea-veggie mixture, and reserved parsley. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
